overall_safety_summary: One or more predefined rules were triggered.

hazards.description: A person is very close to a detected knife.
hazards.explanation: Close interaction with a knife may create a cutting risk.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Reduced grip stability, vision or reaction time may increase the likelihood of injury.
hazards.recommended_action: Use a stable cutting surface and keep fingers away from the knife blade.

hazards.description: A person is very close to detected scissors.
hazards.explanation: Close interaction with scissors may create a cutting or puncture risk.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Reduced dexterity or slower hand control may increase the risk of injury.
hazards.recommended_action: Keep scissors closed when they are not being used and handle them carefully.

hazards.description: A detected cup is positioned near the visible image boundary.
hazards.explanation: The cup may be close to the edge of the work surface and could be knocked over.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: A spilled drink may create a slipping risk or may be difficult to clean quickly.
hazards.recommended_action: Move the cup farther from the edge of the work surface.

hazards.description: A person is very close to a detected oven.
hazards.explanation: Close interaction with an oven may create a burn risk if the appliance or nearby cookware is hot.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Reduced heat sensitivity, balance or reaction speed may increase burn risk.
hazards.recommended_action: Maintain a stable posture and use appropriate protection when interacting with the oven.

uncertainties: The baseline is limited to predefined rules and YOLO detections.
It cannot reason about hazards outside its fixed rule set.
